cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the Rose-Belle data centre (MUS-001) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the ICT ministry sought a sovereign government cloud in 2025 and Cabinet discussed one in April 2026 (MUS-003, MUS-002), so stage 2. The Rose-Belle data centre hosts e-Health, Mobile ID and the government portal (MUS-001), but no rule on state data is in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
